crossRefs.note: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.
With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your…
as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that with it you may grow,
Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.
I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.
Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,

translations.web: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
translations.bsb: I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commandments.
translations.kjv: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
translations.asv: I opened wide my mouth, and panted; For I longed for thy commandments.
